meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 推进计划执行,并行调度多个子代理完成工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你制定好计划后希望一键执行并分派给子代理
copy.tagline_en: Execute your plan and orchestrate parallel subagents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want to execute it with subagents.

howto.what: 当用户下达执行计划的指令后,Claude 会担任协调者:选定要执行的计划,把每个任务拆成小步骤,同时派出多个子代理并行干活;它自己只负责监控进度、验收结果和记录证据,绝不亲手改代码,直到计划所有复选框都完成。
howto.when: 当你说 'start work'、'execute plan' 等指令,或要求运行某个 .omo/plans 计划时触发。

say.note: 它会选取可用计划并启动执行流程。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的 plan-abc 计划
say.note: 指定具体计划文件开始执行。

say.text: 继续执行未完成的计划
say.note: 它会恢复之前未完成的计划进度。

howto.what_en: When told to execute a plan, Claude acts as an orchestrator: it selects the plan, breaks tasks into small steps, dispatches parallel subagents to do the work, monitors progress, verifies results, and records evidence — without writing code itself — until every checkbox is complete.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'start work', 'execute plan', etc., or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: It selects a plan and begins execution.
It resumes progress on the previous plan.
